outcome: risk of complications in the 3rd delivery
cohort: Women with 3 consecutive singleton births at a single institute between 1994 and 2013.
finding: A history of early term birth (ETB) is associated with an increased risk of future preterm birth (PTB) and recurrent ETB, with the risk related to the number and order of prior ETBs.
gest_age: Outcomes defined by <37 weeks (PTB) and 37-38 weeks (ETB).
